propositions: rebar verify-commit-ticket fails with 'ticket store not found' in a fresh linked worktree because pure intercepts bypass the centralized ensure_initialized mount logic
CLI mount logic is currently replicated per dispatch-arm and skipped entirely by pure intercepts, creating a structural possibility of commands forgetting to mount the store

The mount half of init (ensure_initialized with init_only=True calling _create_tracker) must run at a single central CLI choke point before pure intercepts and dispatch to guarantee no store-touching command skips it
Commands with policy=none (init, scratch, explain, pure no-store reads) must not be force-mounted and should continue working without a store
Library and MCP surfaces must remain unchanged and continue requiring explicit init_repo or assuming a mounted store without auto-mount
